Metadata.description: Ship your SaaS in a day.

hero.title: Launch your SaaS this weekend
hero.subtitle: Auth, payments, credits, AI and SEO are already wired up. Change the config, write your product, ship.

features.title: Everything you need to ship
features.subtitle: The boring parts are done, so you can focus on what makes your product different.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Google sign-in and email one-time codes, with sessions and roles built in.

billing.title: Payments
billing.description: Subscriptions and one-time purchases through a provider-agnostic billing layer.

i18n.title: Internationalization
i18n.description: Localized routes and messages. Adding a language is just a config change.

ai.title: AI ready
ai.description: Call any model with the Vercel AI SDK and charge per request in credits.

seo.title: SEO built in
seo.description: Metadata, sitemap, hreflang and Open Graph images out of the box.

fast.title: Fast by default
fast.description: Static rendering, optimized fonts and images, and a tiny client bundle.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start for free. Upgrade when you need more.

stack.question: What is it built with?
stack.answer: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui, with Postgres for data.

payments.question: Which payment providers are supported?
payments.answer: Creem is supported out of the box. Other providers can be added behind the same billing interface.

customize.question: How do I customize it?
customize.answer: Edit site.config.ts for branding, sections and plans, and messages for copy. Your product code lives outside the core folder.

license.question: Can I use it for commercial projects?
license.answer: Yes. Build and sell as many products as you like.

cta.title: Ready to ship?
cta.subtitle: Go from idea to paying customers in a day.
